action.subsystem: Blade performance and Razer Laptop Cooling Pad
action.name: HyperBoost, pad fan, and pad lighting sequence
action.value: HyperBoost selection, maximum pad fan, and static pad lighting probes

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully in Synapse: HyperBoost, maximum cooling-pad fan, and pad static color probes were accepted in operator-marked windows
validation.readbackResult: Synapse UI readback was confirmed by the operator; the paired trace decoded 4518 transactions, but only cooling-pad USB traffic was observed
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully in Synapse: Blade performance returned to Balanced, cooling-pad fan returned to Auto, and lighting returned to the recorded baseline
validation.restorationReadbackResult: The operator confirmed the restored Synapse values; USBPcap stopped gracefully and OpenBlade restarted

sanitizedEvidence.summary: HyperBoost was selected and restored to Balanced in a paired Blade-and-pad capture, but no Blade USB transaction was observed. This trace therefore does not reveal the HyperBoost transport or a safe OpenBlade command.

Maximum fan selection and Auto restoration produced two bounded three-byte cooling-pad message families. Automatic mode also emitted changing calculated fan targets. Field meanings and physical units remain unassigned.
Synapse host-rendered the cooling-pad lighting as 4490 messages with a 59-byte declared payload during the captured lighting sequence.

The operator selected pad Static color 123456 at 50 percent brightness and later restored the recorded baseline. The capture contains the corresponding host-rendered frame window, but physical LED order remains unvalidated.

Synapse exposed no cooling-pad Chroma Sync option on this installation. Two planned synchronization markers are negative-control windows only and do not establish keyboard-to-pad synchronization support.

limitations: Multi-device timing correlation is limited to the explicitly selected Blade and cooling-pad addresses on one USB root.
The absence of Blade USB traffic does not prove HyperBoost is only a Synapse UI gate; it may use another driver, service, ACPI, WMI, or firmware transport not visible to USBPcap.
This capture does not prove HyperBoost power-limit changes, readback, restoration below the UI, safety without the cooling pad, or support on any other model or firmware.
Cooling-pad fan message fields, units, supported range, device readback, failure behavior, and ownership rules remain unconfirmed.
The capture does not establish pad LED geometry, channel order, effect persistence, frame-rate tolerance, or keyboard-to-pad synchronization.
No OpenBlade write, command replay, pad-less HyperBoost action, or third-party pad forwarding was attempted.
notes: A post-capture operator correction records that Synapse provided no Chroma Sync option; planned sync markers must not be treated as successful actions.
The capture ended through the requested stop sentinel with graceful targeted Ctrl+Break.
OpenBlade was running before capture, stopped before USBPcap ownership, and successfully restarted after USBPcap exited.
The raw PCAP, decoded transaction file, state, and operator markers remain local and uncommitted.
